recursive_expansions.SourceProper: (forall z, loss(z) != bottom) AND (exists z, exists r:R, loss(z)=coe r). Both parts are used to justify finite comparisons; no convexity/closedness embedded.
recursive_expansions.SourceSubdifferential: g belongs iff forall y in the entire ambient E, loss(z)+coe(inner g (y-z))<=loss(y). hs is forall played t, forall feasible z, exists g satisfying that test. It is not a selected optimality vector.
recursive_expansions.advance: If exists p in V with IsMinOn [loss+coe(eta^-1*D)] V p, choose that witness and return some p; otherwise none. IsMinOn alone lacks membership, supplied separately. No existence/uniqueness/finite minimum is proved by the definition.
recursive_expansions.iterate: I0=some x0. I(t+1)=I(t).bind(advance with eta(t),loss(t)). hseq binds every I(t) through T to the stated x(t). Its zero clause gives x(0)=x0; successor spec proves membership and actual global constrained minimization.
recursive_expansions.IsMinOn: For every comparison z in V, objective(p)<=objective(z). The producer also establishes p in V. The global comparison is not a desired regret inequality.
recursive_expansions.divergence: psi(a)-psi(b)-fderiv R psi b (a-b). Total library formula; fderiv defaults outside differentiability. Every derivative base used in the five proofs is licensed by hinterior and hd.
recursive_expansions.StrictConvexOn: Convex X AND the strict weighted Jensen inequality for distinct points in X with positive weights summing to one. No uniform modulus.
recursive_expansions.Convex: Every nonnegative weighted combination with weights summing to one stays in the set.
recursive_expansions.DifferentiableOn: DifferentiableWithinAt at every point of int X; openness of int X upgrades it to ambient DifferentiableAt at all visited states.
recursive_expansions.SourceClosed: Every real sublevel set of the embedded regularizer is closed; occurs only as a canary conclusion, not an input to the five general interfaces.
